note: Exceptional-state vocabulary for the MemberFirst Core product. Authored once per VENDOR PRODUCT and reused by every capability recorded against it, on every tenant. A happy-path discovery run cannot discover these screens -- the model never sees them -- so they are configuration rather than something the recorder infers. This is also the right unit of reuse: hundreds of institutions run this one product, and its error screens are a property of the product, not of the institution.

outcomes.description: No member record matched the supplied identifier. A legitimate answer, not a failure: the caller asked about someone who is not a member here.
The member record is restricted and this operator may not service it. Requires a supervisor override outside this system.
The application rejected the submitted values (amount below the institution's minimum, malformed input, missing required field). Retryable with corrected inputs.

outcomeRules.message: No member record matched the supplied identifier.

outcomeRules.message: This member record is restricted; a supervisor override is required.

recoveries.description: An unscheduled maintenance interstitial can appear on any navigation. Dismissing it is safe and returns to the page that was requested.

target.description: the Continue button on the maintenance interstitial (frame omitted: it renders in whichever frame navigated)

recoveries.description: Some institutions configure a compliance acknowledgement after sign-on. Acknowledging it is required to reach any servicing screen and changes no member state.

target.description: the Acknowledge and Continue button (frame omitted: it renders in whichever frame navigated)

recoveries.description: Session timeout mid-flow. Re-run the authentication preamble on the same browser session and resume. Bounded to one attempt: a second expiry in one run means something is wrong beyond an idle timeout.
An unhandled application error. Deliberately NOT retried: on a system of record, re-submitting after an unknown server-side failure risks duplicating a transaction that may have partially applied.

then.reason: The application returned an unexpected system error. A human must confirm whether the transaction partially applied before anything is retried.
